oic.name: Washington Office of the Insurance Commissioner
oic.covers: Insurance companies, agencies, individual producers, appointments, rate/form filings, orders, complaints, and market-conduct/financial examinations as described by OIC.

entity_classes.id: NAIC company code + Washington authorization when an OIC company record says so
entity_classes.establishes: Legal insurer identity; Washington authority only when OIC says so
entity_classes.does_not: NAIC identity alone is not Washington authorization. A brand is not the legal insurer.

entity_classes.id: WAOIC / NPN when the lookup returns a business entity
entity_classes.establishes: Business-entity credential when a live lookup record says so
entity_classes.does_not: Not an insurer. Not an individual producer.

entity_classes.establishes: Person license when a live lookup record says so
entity_classes.does_not: Not an agency. Not published as a person directory here.

entity_classes.id: Producer/agency to insurer relationship when source-native
entity_classes.establishes: Authority to represent a company when the source says so
entity_classes.does_not: Not quality. Not acquired as a bulk graph this ticket.

entity_classes.id: CMS Marketplace or Medicare contract/plan ID when already in the national overlay
entity_classes.establishes: Federal plan identity where already stored
entity_classes.does_not: A plan is not an insurer. Marketplace participation is not OIC authority.

agent_company_lookup.limitation: Consumer lookup for agents, agencies, and companies. Do not scrape.

lists_of_individuals.governing_restriction: RCW 42.56 prohibits providing lists of individuals requested for commercial purposes. OIC requires a commercial-use declaration.

annual_report_aggregates.grain: dated annual-report aggregate, not a roster

producer_roster.caveat: Restricted is not zero. Search-only is not zero. Do not invent a Washington producer count.

agency_roster.caveat: No unrestricted official agency CSV/API was acquired. Missing is not zero.

insurer_company.caveat: Annual-report entity totals are not a current legal-company roster. NAIC != Washington authorization.

annual_aggregates.label: insurance and risk/non-risk bearing entities
annual_aggregates.definition: OIC 2025 annual report aggregate of insurance and risk/non-risk bearing entities supervised/regulated in that report year, split domestic / foreign / alien. This is not a downloadable company roster and is not a current authorized-insurer census.

verify.explains: The OIC Agent and Company Lookup is the live official verification path. A lookup hit is not a TrustHub profile and is not a bulk roster. Existing InsuranceTrustHub insurer/agency research tools remain national graph tools, not a substitute for OIC verification.

complaints_market_conduct.note: File-a-complaint and annual-report context only. No company complaint ranking.

federal_overlay.note: Committed CMS county summaries and Medicare routes do not contain a Washington-safe Marketplace plan census. Existing national CMS/NAIC identities are not Washington OIC authorization. No new federal ingest was performed.

identity_rules.UNSAFE: name-only order/complaint attach; producer mailing lists

contacts.policy: Reuse accepted canonical business/company contacts only. No individual producer harvest. No internet enrichment.

expansion_ledger.note: This closeout documents OIC access, restrictions, and dated annual-report aggregates. It does not mint canonical organizations, does not acquire restricted producer identities, and does not treat 2,924 as entity growth.

findings.title: OIC's 2025 annual report is a dated entity composition, not a live roster
findings.summary: The official 2025 annual report counts insurance and risk/non-risk bearing entities as an aggregate split domestic / foreign / alien. That is not a current authorized-company download.

findings.title: Producer lists are commercially restricted; company lookup remains search-only
findings.summary: RCW 42.56 and OIC's list-of-individuals process block commercial producer mailing lists. Agent, agency, and company verification stays on the official lookup.

findings.title: Rate filings and orders are official research paths, not scraped bulk files
findings.summary: SERFF Filing Access and the OIC orders search are live official tools. A rate filing is not a consumer quote. An order is not a quality score. Name-only attach is unsafe.
doesNotMean: TrustHub has a complete Washington order extract

findings.title: Federal Marketplace/Medicare evidence is not Washington OIC authority
findings.summary: No Washington-safe Marketplace plan census is in the committed CMS overlays used here. Existing NAIC/CMS identities stay national. Marketplace participation is not state authority.
doesNotMean: CMS listing authorizes a company in Washington
